title: Stepwise private-connect storyboards and upgrade action-slate
creator: Oliver Chen
description: Design a compact, stepwise visual flow for Private/VPC onboarding that covers: initial network discovery, operator approval flow, CLI-assisted appliance installer, and a lightweight upgrade slate UI that surfaces recent firmware/agent releases and one-click apply fallback. Deliverables: 6 storyboard frames (mobile + desktop variants), 3 screenshot overlays for actual console views, an animated microflow for live-demo, and a set of tokens/styles for dev handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Six storyboard frames show a complete end-to-end operator journey from network detection to final verification
Desktop and mobile variants for each storyboard frame are provided as PNG and Figma components
Upgrade slate mockups include states: idle, pending, applying, failed with rollback CTA
Console screenshot overlays are annotated and linked to the corresponding component tokens in the design system
Design files uploaded to Drive and a handoff checklist added to the ticket
Engineering signoff obtained on format and export specs (SVGs, PNGs, Lottie where applicable)
